title: claimspec v1 — error
description: What a command writes to stdout under --json when it refuses to run (exit 2) or is invoked wrongly (exit 3), so a caller handles one shape whatever the cause. The human message is also on stderr. A command that already writes a document for the refusal (an undetermined --changed writes the status document, with run.exitCode 2) is not given a second one. A caller reads `error` first: when it is present nothing was measured.

kind.description: Stable name of the cause. Exit 3: `usage` (a request wrong whatever the repository holds: a bad value, an unknown option, flags that cannot be combined). Exit 2: `claims-file` (the claims file is missing or invalid), `git` (git failed), `spec-document` (a spec document on disk does not conform), `refused` (a command declined and said why on stderr), `internal` (a defect in testguard, not in the project) and the precondition kinds, each a named way the run cannot be made safely: see PRECONDITION_KINDS in src/probe/precondition-error.mjs.
